heroHeadline: Yaroslavl Refinery Ablaze as Half of Russia's Top Diesel Plants Now Curtailed or Shut
heroSubtitle: A drone strike sets fire to the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl — its ninth this year — days after Reuters found three of Russia's six largest diesel refineries halted or slashed output, while nearly half of stations nationwide now lack AI-92 or AI-95 gasoline
